input.quote: (viii) it is the rightful owner or licensee of all intellectual property rights to the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder;
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property or data-ownership article. The only IP-adjacent provisions are Kubient's warranty that it owns all IP in "the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder" (p0040), the narrow platform access licence in section 2 which is "non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable" and is revoked on termination (p0002, p0021), and the allocation of responsibility (not retention of rights) for AP's Content in section 6(a) (p0025). So AP has no licence at all to deliverables/products delivered and no contractual limit on Kubient's use of AP's Content, Requests or visitor data. That fails both the preferred and fallback positions. We propose the fallback rather than preferred deliverable-ownership assignment, since Kubient's ownership warranty in section 9(b)(viii) would require collateral rewrites: Kubient keeps its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform, AP receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for its business, and any Kubient licence in AP data is limited to processing solely to provide the Services.

proposal.summary: Add IP/data clause: Kubient keeps generic tools and platform; AP gets perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to deliverables with modification and sublicensing rights; Kubient's licence to AP data limited to providing the Services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership or IP clause, so we have no rights in Kubient's deliverables and no limit on Kubient's use of our content and data. We have added our fallback position: Kubient keeps its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for our business, and any Kubient licence in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

ops.text: Kubient retains ownership of its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform. Kubient hereby grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables and products delivered hereunder for Customer's business. Any license granted to Kubient in the Content or in any other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
